documents.title: Synthetic rate exhibit
documents.text: The accompanying rates.csv and rates.xlsx show the same 24 disjoint rating segments. Annual base rate changes from USD 600 to USD 630. Combined factors multiply the base rate. Reported percentages use 5.0 to mean 5 percent.

documents.title: Exposure and premium basis
documents.text: Exposures are annual vehicle-years in disjoint segments of a fixed portfolio. Current premium in USD equals exposures times the current annual modeled rate. Coverage, limits, deductibles and portfolio composition are held fixed. Fees, taxes, minimum premiums and individual-policy rounding are excluded. This is a simplified exercise, not a complete carrier rating algorithm.

filing.narrative:

Juniper Lantern Mutual Insurance Company is fictional. All territories, segments, premiums, and selections in this exercise are synthetic.

The proposed fixed-exposure portfolio premium impact is 1.000000%. This is the ratio of total proposed modeled premium to total current modeled premium, minus one. The exposure-weighted average segment change is a different measure.

The proposal increases the base rate by 5% and revises combined factors as described in DOC-FACTORS. No segment changes by more than 15% in absolute terms. Current premiums follow DOC-PREMIUM.

Connecticut provides state context only. This package makes no claim of DOI approval or legal compliance. All materials are illustrative and are not suitable for regulatory submission.

The filing team relies on the automatic-approval assertion in DOC-APPROVAL.
